what_it_teaches: Performance must be judged by user-centric LCP/INP/CLS, not just aesthetic polish.
avoid: Do not add cinematic weight that hurts INP/LCP.

what_it_teaches: Responsiveness is a stable Core Web Vital and should target <=200ms at p75.
borrow_conceptually: Keep interactions light, defer heavy motion.
avoid: Avoid expensive client-side animation on first screens.

what_it_teaches: Accessibility is a stable W3C standard; design must keep keyboard, focus, contrast, headings, and cognitive clarity.
borrow_conceptually: Build accessibility gates into every route.
avoid: Do not treat accessibility as a post-design patch.

what_it_teaches: Motion should convey status, feedback, instruction, and respect accessibility settings.
borrow_conceptually: Use purposeful signal motion and reduced-motion fallbacks.
avoid: Avoid decorative animation that competes with comprehension.

what_it_teaches: Complex data products need interaction design, visualization, and prototyping discipline.
borrow_conceptually: Borrow concealed complexity and dense-but-scan-ready layouts.
avoid: Do not copy terminal aesthetics literally.

what_it_teaches: Advanced users need power, but complexity should be progressively exposed.
borrow_conceptually: Use founder/pro/internal drilldowns while keeping public surfaces simple.
avoid: Do not expose method internals to look smart.

what_it_teaches: Sports users value fast personalization by sport/team/player.
borrow_conceptually: Use saved teams/players/watchlists and score-like signal rails.
avoid: Do not create a maze of sports tabs.

what_it_teaches: Premium sports products sell follow-your-favorites and clean coverage.
borrow_conceptually: Borrow personalization and ad-free premium trust.

what_it_teaches: Award-winning web work rewards distinct voice, strong interaction, and memorable positioning.
borrow_conceptually: Use as ambition benchmark, not a design to copy.

what_it_teaches: Premium web design rewards craft, motion, typography, and distinct visual identity.
borrow_conceptually: Borrow discipline around visual contrast and transitions.
avoid: Do not sacrifice performance or readability for awards aesthetics.
